title: The Bargain That Wasn't
story: In the Glassblowers' Bazaar, Pribblewax the Bargain Fiend swirls between the stalls shouting "HALF OFF! HALF OFF!" — but only after he has secretly puffed every price up by 60 percent. Mr 6 needs one climbing rope to reach a kitten stranded on the bell-tower, and the fiend is grinning like he's already won.
question: The rope's honest price is 250 sunspar chips. Pribblewax raises the price by 60%, then takes half off the new price. How many sunspar chips does Mr 6 actually pay?
solution: The markup is 60% of 250 = 150 chips, so the puffed-up price is 250 + 150 = 400 chips.
Mr 6 pays 200 sunspar chips — less than the honest price of 250!
praise: Handling the percent was the right first move — the second step was taking half of the NEW price, not of the original one.
hint: Do the two changes in order: first grow 250 by 60%, and only then cut that result in half.
victory: Mr 6 paid, tipped his helmet, and announced to the whole bazaar that Pribblewax's "bargain" was 50 chips cheaper than plain honest shopping. The fiend shrieked, popped like a soap bubble, and every price in the market snapped back to normal.
imagePrompt: A smirking smoke-and-coin fiend hovering over a glassblowers' market stall of glittering rope and lanterns at dusk, as a small numeral-six knight calmly holds up a chalk slate of arithmetic to the astonished crowd.
